name: Acute angle-closure glaucoma screening
condition: Sudden eye pain (possible acute angle-closure glaucoma)
description: Sudden eye pain with vision changes is a medical emergency. This check looks for signs of angle-closure glaucoma, which needs treatment within hours to prevent permanent vision loss.
time_criticality: Hours — can cause permanent vision loss

citations.text: American Academy of Ophthalmology. Angle-closure glaucoma: symptoms and emergency care (EyeSmart patient information).
Weinreb RN, Aung T, Medeiros FA. The pathophysiology and treatment of glaucoma: a review. JAMA. 2014;311(18):1901-1911.

validated_population: Not a validated score. Pattern based on the typical presentation of acute angle-closure glaucoma described by the American Academy of Ophthalmology.
self_report_note: Eye pressure can only be measured by a clinician. Many other serious eye conditions cause sudden pain and blurred vision, so any sudden eye pain needs same-day care.
license_note: Pattern logic and question wording are original to OLA BOT, based on the public guidance cited. Not a validated scoring instrument.

red_flags.question: Did a chemical splash into your eye, or did something hit or go into your eye?
red_flags.help: For a chemical splash, rinse the eye with clean running water for 15 minutes, then get emergency care.

items.question: Do you have sudden, severe pain in one eye?
items.help: Pain that came on quickly, within hours, not gradually over days.

items.question: Do you see halos (rainbow rings) around lights?
items.help: High eye pressure makes the front of the eye swell, which causes rings around light bulbs or streetlights.

items.question: Is your vision blurry or hazy in that eye right now?
items.help: Cover the other eye and compare.

items.question: Is the white of that eye red or pink?
items.help: Look in a mirror and compare with the other eye.

items.question: Do you have nausea, vomiting, or stomach pain along with the eye pain?
items.help: High eye pressure can cause these symptoms.

items.question: When did this start?
items.help: Your best estimate of when the pain or vision change began.

scoring.pattern_text: Concerning for acute angle-closure glaucoma if: sudden severe eye pain AND (blurred vision OR halos around lights). Red eye and nausea/vomiting support the pattern.
scoring.threshold_text: Pattern check, not a score. Routing: sudden eye pain with blurred vision or halos, or any symptoms that began within 6 hours → emergency department now; sudden eye pain for 6–24 hours → eye doctor or emergency department immediately; otherwise same-day care.

levels.label: Pattern CONCERNING for acute angle-closure glaucoma
levels.interpretation: Your symptoms raise concern for angle-closure glaucoma or another serious eye condition.

levels.label: Pattern ATYPICAL for angle-closure glaucoma
levels.interpretation: Your symptoms do not match the typical pattern of angle-closure glaucoma, but eye pain still needs prompt evaluation.

steps.label: Sudden eye pain with blurred vision
Sudden eye pain with halos around lights
Symptoms started within the last 6 hours
Sudden eye pain that started 6–24 hours ago

ed_now.label: Potential eye emergency: go to the emergency room now
ed_now.interpretation: This pattern is concerning for acute angle-closure glaucoma, a sight-threatening emergency. Vision loss can happen within hours if untreated.
ed_now.recommendation: Go to the emergency room NOW. Do not delay.

care.where_detail: Nearest hospital emergency department. Call 911 or go to the nearest ER.
ed_redirect: You cannot get to an emergency room quickly: call 911
self_care: Do not drive yourself if your vision is blurred. Ask someone to drive you or call 911.
Bring a list of your medicines. Some cold, allergy, and bladder medicines can trigger this condition.

eye_immediate.label: Eye pain needs care immediately
eye_immediate.interpretation: Sudden eye pain that began 6–24 hours ago needs same-day evaluation, including an eye pressure check.
eye_immediate.recommendation: See an eye doctor or go to the emergency room immediately.

care.where_detail: Emergency department, or an eye doctor (ophthalmologist or optometrist) who can see you right away. Most urgent care clinics cannot measure eye pressure.
ed_redirect: Vision gets worse or goes dark
Severe eye pain with nausea or vomiting
self_care: Do not drive yourself if your vision is blurred. Ask someone to drive you or call 911.

same_day.label: Eye pain needs same-day evaluation
same_day.interpretation: Your symptoms do not match the typical pattern of angle-closure glaucoma, but eye pain still needs prompt evaluation.
same_day.recommendation: See an eye doctor, urgent care, or emergency department today.

care.where_detail: Eye doctor same-day appointment, urgent care, or emergency department. Call ahead: urgent care may not be able to measure eye pressure.
ed_redirect: Vision gets worse or goes dark
Severe eye pain with nausea or vomiting
self_care: Do not drive yourself if your vision is blurred. Ask someone to drive you or call 911.
